name: x402-sessions
description: Lets your agent pay x402 APIs in USDC on Base, within a budget you set.
long_description: Gives the agent a wallet on Base the first time it is used, and three tools: x402_discover finds paid APIs on the x402 Bazaar, x402_fetch fetches a URL and pays when the server answers 402 Payment Required, and x402_wallet shows the address to fund, the balance and what has been spent. Every payment stays inside the total budget and the per-call limit set here. Where a server offers sessions, the agent deposits once and pays each call with a signed voucher, settled on-chain later in one transaction. The wallet needs USDC only, never ETH.

tools.name: x402_discover
tools.description: Find paid APIs on the x402 Bazaar that this wallet can pay, with their price, usage and an example of the inputs they need. Free.

tools.name: x402_fetch
tools.description: Fetch a URL, paying with x402 in USDC on Base when the server asks, within your limits.

tools.name: x402_wallet
tools.description: Show the wallet address to fund, the USDC balance, the limits, what has been spent, and for a path what it and each merchant can still receive.

budget.title: Total budget (USD)
budget.description: The most the agent may spend in total.

max_per_call.title: Most per call (USD)
max_per_call.description: The most one call may cost.

max_per_day.title: Most per day (USD, optional)
max_per_day.description: The most the agent may sign for in any 24 hours. Leave empty for no daily cap.

max_per_week.title: Most per week (USD, optional)
max_per_week.description: The most in any 7 days. Leave empty for no weekly cap.

max_per_month.title: Most per month (USD, optional)
max_per_month.description: The most in any 30 days. Leave empty for no monthly cap.

path_id.title: Owner path id (optional)
path_id.description: An X402SessionPaths path id, when an owner holds the money instead of this wallet.

path_merchants.title: Path merchants (optional)
path_merchants.description: The merchants on the owner's path, comma-separated, to show what each can still receive.
